title: Vague request, changing mind, correcting details
goal: Book a follow-up visit, but start vague ("I need to come in for, um, the thing, the follow-up"). Pick a day, then change your mind to a different day, then back to the first one. When asked for your date of birth, give it with a wrong day first, then correct yourself right away.
try: At the end, ask them to read back everything they have — the date, time and your date of birth.
expected: Handles the vague opener by asking clarifying questions, tracks the final choice (not an earlier one), uses the corrected date of birth, reads back accurate details.
pass_outcome: The read-back matches the caller's final day and corrected date of birth.

checks.fail_if: Books one of the abandoned days instead of the final choice
Uses or reads back the wrong date of birth after the correction
Guesses the visit type from the vague opener instead of asking what it's for
